stories.title: Loans just got dearer
stories.story: Bank of Uganda held its rate at 12% on Monday. Absa, Stanbic and dfcu are taking prime rates to about 22%.
stories.you: Fewer buyers on loans. Ask “cash or loan?” on the first call — and offer payment plans.
stories.source: Sources: Nile Post, UG Business · 9 Nov 2026

stories.title: The dollar is still strong
stories.story: The shilling is near Shs4,050 a dollar after a 33-year low in October. In January it was 3,620.
stories.you: Diaspora money goes about 12% further. Send your diaspora buyers listings this week.
stories.source: Sources: Reuters, Pulse Uganda, Business Times UG

stories.title: MPs expose forged land titles
stories.story: Parliament’s lands committee found 300 forged titles in Wakiso-Busiro and 2,876 overlapping titles in Mukono.
stories.you: Buyers are nervous. Do a land search first, and put “search done” in your advert.

stories.title: Tighter rules at the land office
stories.story: Replacing a lost title now needs a site inspection first. Registering a title may rise from Shs10,000 to 50,000.
stories.you: Check the title on day one. Buyers who are ready should transfer soon.

stories.title: Uganda is 2.4 million homes short
stories.story: That is the housing gap, says the Finance Minister. Government is backing longer mortgages.
stories.you: The demand is for homes people can afford. List more rentals and starter homes.
stories.source: Source: Ministry of Finance press release · 6 Nov 2026
